word_limit_counts: No stated body word limit in the Guide for Authors
required_sections: Data statement (research data Option C: deposit, cite and link, or explain)
preprint_policy: Preprint sharing allowed (Elsevier sharing policy); free SSRN posting offered
notes: Highlights required at submission: 3-5 bullets, max 85 chars each. Abstract must stand alone, avoid references. Appendices labelled A, B; figures within them Fig. A.1 etc. Footnotes sparingly. Colour figures must be accessible to impaired colour vision. Single-anonymised review. American or British English, not a combination. Ethics statement with approval date and reference number required.
